title: RegistrarLandscapeStat
description: One aggregate statistic in a quarterly registrar_landscape edition. Each stat is a count (or median) computed over the registrar set Open Domain Data tracks, derived from the primary capability datasets. It reports a fact, not a ranking.

id.description: Stable slug for the stat; also the last path segment of its canonical URL.

edition.description: Quarterly edition this stat belongs to (e.g. 2026-Q3).

headline.description: True for the small set of headline stats designed to be quoted.

metric.description: Short human label for the capability measured.

statement.description: A denominator-explicit sentence stating the result, safe to quote verbatim.

numerator.description: Count of tracked registrars meeting the condition, or the computed value for non-share stats (e.g. the median).

denominator.description: Size of the tracked set the numerator is over. Null for non-share stats.

percent.description: numerator / denominator as a percentage, one decimal. Null for non-share stats.

unit.description: Unit of the value (e.g. registrars, seconds).

methodology.description: One line stating exactly how the value is counted from the source dataset.

computed_from.description: The primary dataset(s), version(s) and field(s) this stat is computed from.

breakdown.description: Full audit trail: maps each outcome label to the list of registrar ids in that group, so any consumer can reproduce the count.

canonical_url.description: Stable, citable URL for this stat.
